title: Technical debt: Refactoring of libindy tests to perform correct full cleanup
description: We have big amount of libindy tests that doesn't perform resources cleanup. As result we have to use unique names, ports and etc in a lot of tests. It makes support of tests a bit complicated.     This ticket is about refactoring of tests to perform full cleanup:  1. Avoid usage of long custom names. Just use pool1 or wallet1. Look to python/java wrapper.    2. Close all opened handles  3. Think about involving of fixtures like or before/after like approach.
